name: function-call-examples
goal: Function Examples show usable invocation code beside compact expected results and compare changed outputs across examples

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Show authored function calls with compact expected results; compare later outputs to the first example. Preserve actual result versus authored expectation provenance.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized function Examples revision/viewport matrix only asserted field text and expected values. It never required an invocation or visible comparison. Extend that same fixture and matrix, plus documentation parsing and activity examples.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final supporting fixture corpus at 515380ce fails Examples must show a concrete function call at all three widths in a controlled environment; no assertions or example values changed during extraction.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented compact call/result rows and output differences. Codex integrated revision-pinned call/setup metadata, truthful missing-call fallback, and real Activity freshness snippets checked against the function. Fourteen browser cases pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final clean snapshots: red 515380ce fails the required function-call assertion; green 424e3c54 passes all three widths with the complete corpus unchanged. Real usage snippets match the function; report unit suite, lint, types, build and size audit pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Affected UI checks pass: frozen viewport regression, 14 browser cases, 602 report unit tests, types, lint, build and size audit. Repository-wide verification is blocked by an unchanged hooks fixture: expected source bytes 87/148, actual 100/161, reproduced on base 24fcba33. Broad E2E was stopped at this confirmed baseline blocker.
